A CLEAR SEQUENCE OF STEPS

We start with your equipment.

The manufacturer, type and a description of the problem help us prepare a specific service enquiry.

  1. 01

    Describing the situation

    Send us the manufacturer and type of the WWTP, its location and details of the fault symptoms or the maintenance you need.

  2. 02

    Assessing the scope

    We discuss the servicing, diagnostics and follow-up work required.

  3. 03

    Service visit

    Depending on the agreed scope, we carry out an inspection, a repair or a replacement of components.

  4. 04

    Ongoing care

    We agree on recommendations for operation or on follow-up regular maintenance.

BEFORE YOU GET IN TOUCH

What you may want to know.

Do you have a specific installation or brief? Let's go through it together.

+420 736 403 795
Do you service WWTPs from other suppliers?+

Yes. We also service treatment plants we did not supply ourselves, and technologies from various manufacturers. In your enquiry, state the manufacturer, the type of equipment and a description of the service you need.

Can I order regular maintenance?+

Yes. Alongside one-off servicing, we offer regular service programmes and long-term service contracts. The specific scope is agreed according to the equipment and how it is operated.

How is the price of servicing set?+

The price of a specific service is calculated individually according to the distance and the complexity of the job. For a quote, describe the equipment, its location and the problem or requirement.

More about maintenance and serviceability+

We only sell products that can be serviced well and easily.

Most manufacturers, retailers and customers overlook this aspect, yet it is a very important part of the life cycle of all technologies, not only those for water management. A wastewater treatment plant in particular must be easy to service, and all its internal components must be readily accessible and easy to replace. Our range includes only products like that.

If you need maintenance or servicing for your rainwater management system or wastewater treatment plant, we have all the equipment and spare parts needed for the job.

The price of a specific service is always calculated individually, based on the client's distance and the complexity of the job. Do not hesitate to contact us for a quote.

LET'S DISCUSS YOUR BRIEF

Does your WWTP need servicing?

Tell us the manufacturer and type of equipment, where it is installed and a brief description of the problem. This helps us define the next steps correctly.
